created_by: export_deposit_2x2.py (deterministic export of the 2x2 measured-matrix set)
purpose: cleanly named 2x2 measured-matrix set, analogous to the deposited 3x3 set
derivation: identical load paths and projection as the original 2x2 extraction run: M = sym(V^T Op V)

V_gs.npy.path: original run artifact (path not part of this record)

Wfat_s1_i.npy.path: original run artifact (path not part of this record)

Wfat_s1_j.npy.path: original run artifact (path not part of this record)

lw_torus.py.path: original run artifact (path not part of this record)

usage.note: p6_Mgs_i_2x2.npy is the Wilson matrix used by the extraction (run: wilson_choice = ops_wfat_i[1], character (tau,taubar), discrimination 25.7x). NAMING CAVEAT: the deposited files are named after their SOURCE operators (i <- Wfat_s1_i, j <- Wfat_s1_j), whereas the original run script refers to this same matrix internally as 'Mj' and to the opposite direction as 'Mi'. Feeding p6_Mgs_j_2x2.npy instead does not fail loudly: it returns three solutions of the same doubled-Fibonacci class whose residuals do NOT match the deposited ones. Reproduction: extract(p6_Mgs_i_2x2, p6_M_R_2x2, n_starts=240, input_scale=input_scale) returns the three solutions of rotation center (0,0) listed in p6_extraction_2x2.json, reproducing their residuals to all printed digits. n_starts is part of the recipe: the extract() default of 400 returns a superset (8 solutions) that contains those three.
usage.rotation_centers: p6_M_R_2x2.npy is the center (0,0); the two further centers are built by the original run script from the same lattice basis via build_MR_center(ci,cj) and are not deposited as files, so three of the nine entries in p6_extraction_2x2.json are reproducible from this record alone.
